name: Borgul Ramshead
found: Mother's Boarding House, on the porch.
appearance: Towering. Heavyset. Iron keyring at his belt.
sayings: No adventurers. They bring the swamp back with them.
oddly_also: Former slaver. Runs the cleanest house in Nebruz.
dm_notes: He sold lizard-folk captives downriver 20 years ago. Some of the renegade band know his face.
